newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX JGBs, Euroyen still basking from tankan.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX JGBs, Euroyen still basking from tankan.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese Government Bond (JGB) futures continued to bask in post-tankan bullishness, dealers said on Friday.
Dealers said Euroyen futures were mostly range-bound in light trade, with June locked within the 99.31-99.34 range.
Dealers said the Euroyen market ignored news that Japan's unemployment in October worsen to 3.4 percent from 3.3 percent in September.
Neither did the market react to news of Japan's better than expected October housing starts of a 21.4 percent year-on-year increase.
They said Japan's ministry of finance comments that the economy was gradually recovering was seen in line with Wednesday's tankan and reinforced belief of a steady rate policy by the Bank of Japan.
June Euroyen was trading around 99.32 in late trade compared to its IMM close at 99.28. Turnover was around 8,450 lots.

Dealers said Euroyen saw a brief excitement in the morning on speculation over Japan's Tottori Bank news conference. However, it turned out to be an announcement of the bank's listing plans. Most dealers were expecting December Euroyen to stay range-bound at 99.30-99.36 next week.
JGBs remained underpinned by steady demand and expectations of steady rates, expected to last until summer.
After trading to its day low of 126.02, December JGBs ended 11 ticks up at 126.31 on a meagre volume of 738 lots.
Near-term support for December JGBs remained at 126.20 and resistance at 127.00.
Trade in Eurodollars was dull with most U.S. players away for the Thanksgiving weekend.
June Eurodollars ended at 94.44, up a tick from its previous IMM close on a meagre volume of 4,600 lots.
